en.answer:
Even if <<5740>> is activated after <<9990>> has been successfully Summoned, its effect that lets you perform an additional Normal Summon will not be negated. (You can still perform the additional Normal Summon.)

However, if you Normal Summon <<9990>> while <<5740>> is already applying, the effect of <<9990>> will be negated. (You cannot perform the additional Normal Summon.)

This also applies to the following monsters:
● <<23156>>'s ①st effect
● <<11217>>'s effect
● <<9810>>'s effect
● <<9307>>'s effect
● <<11493>>'s effect
en.question:
If <<5740>> is activated after <<9990>> has been Normal Summoned, will <<9990>>'s effect that lets you perform an additional Normal Summon be negated?

Furthermore, if I Normal Summon <<9990>> while <<5740>> is already applying, will that effect be negated?
en.title: Will <<5740>> negate the effect of <<9990>> that lets you Normal Summon an additional monster?

ja.answer:
「<<9990>>」が召喚に成功した後に「<<5740>>」を発動した場合、『自分は通常召喚に加えて１度だけ「ヴェルズ」と名のついたモンスター１体を召喚できる』効果は無効になりません。

また、既に「<<5740>>」の効果が適用されている時に「<<9990>>」を召喚した場合、効果は無効化されますので、もう１度だけ召喚する効果は適用できません。

以下のモンスターにつきましても同様です。
「<<23156>>」①
「<<11217>>」
「<<9810>>」
「<<9307>>」
「<<11493>>」
